data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 6 observations; candidates: Eg5 inhibitors, Microtubule stabilizers, Microtubule destabilizers

candidate_mechanisms.why: Strong mitotic accumulation (frac_mitotic_like 0.178 vs 0.013, z 12.1) with small bright condensed DNA and intense contracted tubulin bodies, plus rounding/retraction with long thin tails, consistent with mitotic kinesin block.

Mitotic accumulation plus increased tubulin heterogeneity/brightness (tub_glcm_contrast z 9.6) and reduced spread area (cell_area z -10.2) with loss of epithelial sheets, consistent with stabilized bundled microtubules.
Same mitotic accumulation and loss of spread morphology with altered tubulin texture; cannot exclude destabilization at single timepoint without resolving polymers vs diffuse tubulin.

notable_cells.why: small isolated very bright round condensed DNA with bright tubulin/actin halo, canonical mitotic-like
small very bright condensed DNA with intense surrounding tubulin/actin in elongated cluster, mitotic-like
pair of small very bright round nuclei with intense tubulin in lower cluster, mitotic-like
small bright red-white round cell with condensed DNA in lower chain, mitotic-like

observations.finding: Increased proportion of small very bright condensed DNA spots vs DMSO where most nuclei are larger dimmer ovals; agrees with frac_mitotic_like z 12.09 (0.178 vs 0.013).

Cells smaller, isolated spindle/teardrop with long thin protrusions vs DMSO cobblestone epithelial sheets; agrees with cell_area z -10.2 (2384 vs 3839) and solidity z -7.8 and roundness z -11.39 (more elongated, less round).
Tubulin more heterogeneous with very bright contracted cell bodies and thin extensions; agrees with tub_glcm_contrast z 9.64.
Actin more variable/patchy with bright clumps and strong cortical edges on contracted cells; agrees with act_std z 9.19 and act_glcm_contrast z 8.37.
Interphase nuclei appear smaller/shorter; agrees with nuc_major_axis z -7.79 (30.5 vs 36.4).
Loss of cell-cell contacts with isolated cells and empty background vs dense DMSO clusters; no direct cell-count / clustering measurement provided so not covered by measurements.

report.uncertainty: Single 6 uM 24h timepoint; resolution insufficient to distinguish monopolar vs multipolar spindles or stabilize vs destabilize; elongated interphase shape with decreased roundness is atypical for pure rounding antimitotics so mixed cytoskeletal effect cannot be excluded.

data.critique: Top+runner-up panel (Actin, Eg5, MT) and not Chol-lowering, and different well/ dose where signature persists. | The atlas comparisons are internally consistent, but the visual phenotype descriptions directly contradict them: phenotype reports point to Eg5 inhibitors, Microtubule stabilizers, and Microtubule destabilizers and note that decreased roundness is atypical for antimitotic. The margin between Chol-lowering and Actin is narrow - 0.45 vs 0.25 - yet it's resting only on atlas frequency, which is biased towards high doses with stronger phenotypes.
data.requested_experiment: Re-evaluate the vigour of the conclusion by comparing the activated well against the known Chol-lowering references specifically. Focusing on the ratio of integrated DNA intensity (nuc_dna_integrated, which is 504.684 vs 400.081 DMSO - moderate increase), which can distinguish polyploidy (increased integrated intensity) from simple condensation (same integrated but smaller area) that could arise from mitotic arrest.
